title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
abstract: arXiv:2611.26624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gap

translated_title: PlayCraft：基于智能体游戏体验设计引人入胜的游戏
translated_abstract: 近期的AI智能体可以生成可玩的游戏，但这些游戏不一定具有吸引力。精通是游戏吸引力的关键来源之一，然而为精通而设计需要大量的人类试玩和调优。我们提出了PlayCraft，一个自动化框架，它使用基于视觉的智能体来玩游戏，并利用其详细的游戏体验来修改游戏，以促进玩家的精通。从初始游戏开始，PlayCraft在游玩和制作之间交替进行。在游玩阶段，玩家智能体观察游戏画面、使用控制器，并在多轮重复的游戏回合中追求游戏目标，同时保留记忆。每回合结束后，它会报告自己的进展、结果、决策和反思。在制作阶段，制作者智能体利用这些报告来修改游戏。它估计玩家能力，预测不同熟练度水平下的表现，并将这些预测与目标学习进程进行比较，从而诊断游戏并弥补差距。
tldr: PlayCraft提出了一个自动化框架，让视觉智能体反复试玩游戏并基于其游玩报告（进展、决策、反思等）自动修改游戏设计，使游戏更有助于玩家精通，从而提升游戏的吸引力。
en_tdlr: PlayCraft is an automated framework in which a vision-based agent repeatedly plays a game and a crafter agent uses the resulting play experience reports to revise the game toward mastery, making it more engaging.
